lines.en: Hooves crackle through the silent forest
Hooves echo on the pine needles
Racing through the thick underbrush
Stamping on leaves, deafeningly loud
Rushing through the forest like the wind
Hooves on mossy ground
Through the forest, hooves stomp
Jogging through the forest like lightning
Hooves awaken the sleeping forest
Zipping through thick branches
The herd tramps across Eden's grass
Horns push through the low branches
Kin follow behind, hooves in one rhythm
It races the creek bank, splashing water
Standing in the woods, gazing far
Grazing peacefully on grass
Raising head, sniffing the air
Licking hooves, grooming itself
Lowering head, staring at the ground
Walking casually in the woods
Standing still, gazing
Lying on the grass, relaxed
Grooming itself, staying clean
Enjoys this quiet forest
Spotting the player, lifting head alertly
Noticing the player, low groan
Smelling the player, becoming alert

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，随时准备攻击
lines.en: Fixing the player with eyes, ready to attack
Groaning a warning, player take note
Noticing the player, soft roar

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，随时准备冲锋
lines.en: Fixing on the player, ready to charge

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，准备发起攻击
lines.en: Targeting the player, ready to attack
Eden's grass — and I'm watching you.
Groaning a warning, battle ready
Hooves strike, but where to run?
Strength bound, pain too much.
Blood seeps, pain unbearable.
My four legs buckle, and I cannot lift my horn.
Tired, strength less.
Severely hurt, cannot move.
Tired, breath faint.
Tired, down for good.
Tired, can’t stand.
Tired, no way out.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒令我着迷，但你很危险。
lines.en: The light you emit is captivating, but you are dangerous.
You hold up that light, and my horn itches.

lines.zh: 用你那微弱的光吸引我？哈哈！
lines.en: Use your weak light to attract me? Ha ha!

lines.zh: 你的存在就像一把双刃剑。
lines.en: Your existence is like a double-edged sword.

lines.zh: 我的力量远超你的想象。
lines.en: My strength far exceeds your imagination.
You want to catch me? Dream on!

lines.zh: 不要试图驯服我，只会徒增烦恼。
lines.en: Don't try to tame me; it will only cause you trouble.

lines.zh: 你似乎很有营养，但别吃我。
lines.en: You seem nutritious, but don’t eat me.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒很耀眼，但也危险。
lines.en: The light on you is bright, but dangerous.

lines.zh: 靠近我会付出代价，小心点。
lines.en: Getting close will cost you, be careful.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，准备战斗！
lines.en: You’re in my way; prepare for battle!
Move out of my way, or you’ll die!
Let me teach you a lesson.

lines.zh: 你的力量在我眼中微不足道。
lines.en: Your strength is insignificant to me.
Step back, or I’ll attack.

lines.zh: 你的攻击太弱了，连边都碰不到。
lines.en: Your attacks are too weak to even touch me.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的去路，必须清除。
lines.en: You’re blocking my path; you must be eliminated.
Avoid me if you don’t want to fight.

lines.zh: 你的攻击对我不构成威胁。
lines.en: Your attacks pose no threat to me.
Step back, or you’ll get hurt.
The whole herd shoves you aside!

lines.zh: 这一撞带着伊甸的力量！
lines.en: This shove carries Eden's own strength!

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣是艰难的。
lines.en: Finding a mate is difficult.
I need a同类.

lines.zh: 我在这里寻找我的伴侣。
lines.en: I’m looking for my mate here.

lines.zh: 我的配偶必须非常强壮。
lines.en: My mate must be very strong.

lines.zh: 寻找一个能与我并肩作战的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner to fight by my side.

lines.zh: 配偶是我们力量的源泉。
lines.en: Our mate is the source of our strength.

lines.zh: 我需要一个可以分享力量的伴侣。
lines.en: I need a partner to share my strength with.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣必须同样强大。
lines.en: My mate must be equally strong.

lines.zh: 找到合适的人，我们才能更强大。
lines.en: Find the right one, and we can be stronger.

lines.zh: 寻找一个能与我共存的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner to coexist with me.

lines.zh: 用角挑起食物，闪烁着光亮。
lines.en: Jab at the food, glowing brightly.

lines.zh: 尖牙轻舔力量肉，慢慢咀嚼。
lines.en: Sharp teeth gently lick the power meat, slowly chewing.
Bend down to eat grass, savoring the taste.
Stroll around, munching on grass.

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢开不需要的东西。
lines.en: Kick away anything unwanted with a hoof.

lines.zh: 寻找半熟的力量肉，补充能量。
lines.en: Search for half-cooked power meat for energy.

lines.zh: 啃食掉落的半熟力量肉。
lines.en: Bite into the half-cooked power meat.
Indulge in the delicious meat.
Swallow the Eden Soul that dropped.

lines.zh: 用角挑起掉落的半熟肉。
lines.en: Jab at the dropped half-cooked meat.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，眼中闪烁凶光。
lines.en: Lock onto prey, eyes glowing menacingly.

lines.zh: 警惕四周，寻找可攻击目标。
lines.en: Scan the surroundings, seeking a target.

lines.zh: 我把你从整群里分出来
lines.en: I single you out from the rest of the herd.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，眼中露出杀机。
lines.en: Notice the player, eyes filled with intent.

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢开障碍物，锁定目标。
lines.en: Kick away obstacles, locking onto the target.
Lock onto the sound, pinpointing its source.

lines.zh: 锁定远处的目标，准备冲锋。
lines.en: Lock onto the distant target, preparing to charge.

lines.zh: 锁定玩家，准备发动攻击。
lines.en: Target the player, ready to attack.
Lock onto the target, closing in quickly.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，眼中凶光闪烁。
lines.en: Spot the player, eyes glowing with malevolence.
Newcomer, Eden does not welcome you.
Its kin whinny and fan out around you.

lines.zh: 你身上的外来气味太浓。
lines.en: The outsider smell on you is thick.

lines.zh: 它用蹄刨地，向同伴示意。
lines.en: It paws the dirt to signal the herd.

lines.zh: 你的脚步惊动了整片林子。
lines.en: Your steps have startled the whole grove.

lines.zh: 它认出你不是伊甸的东西。
lines.en: It knows you do not belong to Eden.

lines.zh: 角中带着致命力量，瞄准玩家。
lines.en: The horn glows with lethal power, aiming at the player.

lines.zh: 用角攻击玩家，力量惊人。
lines.en: Charge the player with the horn, power radiating.

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢向玩家，力量惊人。
lines.en: Kick the player with a powerful hoof strike.

lines.zh: 力量凝聚在角尖，准备一击致命。
lines.en: Power gathers at the horn tip, ready for a deadly strike.

lines.zh: 攻击玩家，力量冲击四散。
lines.en: Strike the player, power scattering.

lines.zh: 用角挑开玩家，力量可见。
lines.en: Jab at the player, power visible.

lines.zh: 用蹄子踢开玩家，力量惊人。
lines.en: Kick the player away, power evident.

lines.zh: 力量汇聚在角尖，准备攻击。
lines.en: Power concentrates at the horn tip, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 角中光芒四射，力量惊人。
lines.en: Glowing from the horn, power radiates.

lines.zh: 用角挑向玩家，力量可见。
lines.en: Jab at the player, power visible.
It lowers its forequarters, horn leveled.
Its kin close in from both sides.
The horn tip lines up with your chest.
It paws the ground, waiting to charge.
Its hind legs coil, ready to spring.
One whinny and the herd goes silent.
It circles upwind of you.
Its horn glows a milky white.

lines.zh: 它往后退了三步，好起跑。
lines.en: It backs off three steps for a run-up.

lines.zh: 草叶被它踩得伏倒成线。
lines.en: The grass flattens into a line under its hooves.
Horns flash, claws slash!
Breathe fire, scorch you!
Drop force meat, pick up!
Hooves stomp, dust rises!
Souloflight flickers, beware!
Horn strike, fatal blow!
Strength flows from flesh!
Souls scatter, flying free!
You taste only pain!
Roar shakes, I hunt now!
My horn punches through your armor!
Eden's grass is no place for you to stand!
This hoof shatters your shield!
Herd, all at once!
You cannot outrun four legs!
Get out of Eden's world!
My horn knows only my own herd!
Taste an Eden horn!
You will not leave this grove alive!

lines.zh: 力量肉很快就是你的了！
lines.en: Soon you will be power meat!

lines.zh: 黑暗中，伊甸独角兽现身！
lines.en: In darkness, Eden Cadillons appear!
Hostile in Eden, they spawn!

lines.zh: 它们在阴影中等待猎物！
lines.en: They wait in shadows for prey!
Eden Cadillons gather!
They appear at nightfall!
Eden woods, danger lurks!
Deep Eden, fear arrives!
Eden Cadillons, formidable!
Beware, they attack in swarms!
Souls of Eden, awakening!
Eden's grass has grown tall again.
The herd is complete. We patrol the grove.
Burned, pain unbearable.
Fell, head and body apart.
Drowned, life fading.
Exploded, flesh torn.
Arrow pierced, pain deep.
Magic burned, soul scattered.
Starving, weak and thin.
Lightning struck, electrocuted.
Void devoured, soul lost.
